text: Scanning the relative delay traces the HOM dip; its depth (the visibility V = 1 - 2*P_min) equals the ___ M = |<psi1|psi2>|^2 of the two photons, a direct measure of whether they are truly the same photon.
explanation: The HOM visibility equals the indistinguishability M = |<psi1|psi2>|^2; perfectly indistinguishable photons (M = 1) give a dip to zero coincidences. This is the acceptance metric that fault-tolerant photonic sources must push above 99.9%.
